mitre_tactics.justification: Command and Scripting Interpreter (Execution) — Adversary abuses command-line or scripting interpreters to execute malicious code. Technique ID mapped from threat intelligence corpus.

ttps.justification: Technique applies because: injection. The Exploit Public-Facing Application technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Initial Access phase behavior (analyst inference from advisory text).
ttps.observed_behavior: NOT OBSERVED. Hypothesis from the vulnerability description: exploiting 'CVE-2026-118869 - SHIRASAGI OS Command Injection Vulnerability' could enable Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190) in the Initial Access phase. ttps.detection_hint: Alert on unexpected process spawning from web server processes (IIS, Apache, nginx, Tomcat). Monitor for shell commands (cmd.exe, bash, sh) launched by web service accounts.
ttps.kql_example: DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ('w3wp.exe','httpd','nginx','tomcat') and FileName has_any ('cmd.exe','powershell.exe','bash','sh')
